summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue but may introduce behavioral regression and lacks sufficient tests.

issues.description: The change directly modifies the `hist_kwargs` dictionary to include `range=bin_range`, which could affect other parts of the code that rely on the behavior of `hist()` when `density=True`. This needs thorough testing to ensure no unintended side effects.

While the patch fixes the immediate issue, there are no additional tests provided to cover the new behavior. More comprehensive tests should be added to ensure the fix works across different scenarios and does not introduce regressions.
